chunks: That is because they said: 'The Fire will not touch us for a few days.' And their own fabrications deceived them in their faith.
ai.seo_question: Why did the disbelievers think the Fire would only last a few days?
ai.summary: This verse elucidates the root cause of the disbelievers' punishment: their arrogant assertion that the Fire would be merely temporary, lasting only 'a few days.' Their self-deception arose from the fabrications they invented regarding God and the Hereafter, which misled them in their religious understanding. In Shia exegesis, this highlights how intellectual pride and fabricated doctrines can distort one's perception of divine justice.
